results.name: Citi to acquire rewards platform Kard to power personalized card offers | Ecosystem UK
results.content:
# Citi to acquire rewards platform Kard to power personalized card offers  
● 4 hours ago  
**What's the deal?** [Citi](https://app.dealroom.co/companies/citicorp)'s US Consumer Cards business has agreed to acquire [Kard Financial](https://app.dealroom.co/companies/nancypickard), a commerce media and rewards platform that helps banks and fintechs deliver personalized offers. Terms were not disclosed, and Citi said they are not material to its financial results.  
**What does [Kard](https://app.dealroom.co/companies/kard_) do?** The company connects financial institutions and merchants using verified transaction data and merchant-funded rewards. Its machine learning-powered matching simplifies rewards for card issuers and helps brands reach high-intent consumers with measurable outcomes.  
**What's the endgame?** Citi wants to combine its scale and payments expertise with Kard's technology, talent, and merchant relationships. The goal is to deliver more personalized rewards to customers while opening new engagement opportunities for merchants and brands.  
**Why now?** Citi framed the move as advancing its Investor Day priorities and strengthening its commerce ecosystem strategy. Kard already serves millions of cardholders across a network of fintechs, banks, and neobanks; Citi brings roughly 70 million cardmembers.
**What they said:** "We're focused on helping customers get more value from their everyday spending," said Abhinav Anand, Citi's head of value cards, lending and commerce. Founder and chief executive officer Ben Mackinnon called the deal "an exciting new chapter for Kard, our team and our customers."  
**What's next?** The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions. Citi and Kard will continue to operate independently until it closes. [Keefe, Bruyette & Woods](https://app.dealroom.co/companies/keefe_bruyette_woods) advised Kard, while [Sullivan & Cromwell](https://app.dealroom.co/companies/sullivan_cromwell) counseled Citi and [Latham & Watkins](https://app.dealroom.co/companies/latham_watkins) counseled Kard.  
**The signal:** Card issuers are increasingly treating rewards as a data-driven commerce channel, not just a perk. By bringing Kard's merchant-funded offers in-house, Citi is betting that personalized loyalty can deepen engagement across both its cardholders and the brands trying to reach them.
